sampling.method: shared seeded random held-out window order across four poles; stop each pole after 16 distinct strong windows; one uniform activation per sampled window

notes: Budgeted joint coverage sampling: four poles share the seeded random held-out window order of L34/N4070-, with each pole using its own contribution-id seed for uniform per-window selection. The 0.30 threshold and first-64-token exclusion match graph.coverage.draw; each pole stops after at least 16 distinct strong windows instead of oversampling 48. The final batch can contain extra qualifying windows; its batch size is recorded in methods.sampling. No label-based sample selection. Activations are the original float16 readings; the PR reports an additional bfloat16 check of these fixed positions. Marks judge the registered label without broadening it. Counted food/nutrient intake or a clinical intervention timed to a developmental phase, a dose/treatment interval, or a medical event. Generic symptom lists, treatment choice without timing, and incubation duration without a scheduled intervention are false. These marks classify corpus context; they do not endorse its medical claims.
